issues.description: The Frame::from_raw_spec model retains an unused paddr parameter even though the constructed frame is determined entirely by slot_perm and metadata_perm.
issues.rationale: The complete fixed body at lines 160-173 constructs the frame pointer from slot_perm.ptr() and stores the supplied permissions without reading paddr. The canonical-spec-models finding is therefore limited to redundant model input and the unnecessary address argument at call sites. This evidence alone does not establish a missing safety precondition or an unsafe executable implementation.
